info.name: Nearby - Chat and Notification API
info.description: Chat (SRS 3.5) and notifications (SRS 3.9) over REST. Run the identity, area and listing collections first: the buyer needs a verified area covering an ACTIVE listing of the seller, and both need an account. Set buyerPhone, buyerPassword, sellerPhone, sellerPassword and listingId in the collection variables, then run the folders in order. Real time over STOMP is in docs/api/chat-stomp.md. Contract: docs/api/chat-api.md.

request.description: The buyer must be registered, with a verified area that covers the listing. Run the identity and area collections first.
The seller owns the listing in {{listingId}}. Set listingId in the collection variables (an ACTIVE listing of the seller).

item.name: 1. FC1 Open the chat from a listing (A10)
Open the conversation (201 the first time)
Open it again: the same id (200)
2. FC2 Chat screen over REST (A18)
item.description: The 31st message in a minute is 429 CHAT_RATE_LIMITED; send in a loop with the Collection Runner to see it.

item.name: Repeat the same clientMsgId: stored once (200)
Seller reads up to the newest (204)
Error: someone who is not a member (404)

request.description: sizeBytes is the real size of the JPEG you pick in the next step.

item.name: Upload the JPEG (pick a file in the Body tab)

request.description: Goes to the object storage, not to the backend. Select a small JPEG as the body.

item.name: Poll until READY (run again if UPLOADING)
Error: the same image again (422 IMAGE_INVALID)
Error: not an image type (400 INVALID_IMAGE)
Save: trade push off, quiet hours 23:00-06:30
